Invert Sugar Azúcar invertido. CAS — 8013-17-0. ATC — C05BB03. ATC Vet — QC05BB03. Pharmacopoeias. Br. and US include preparations of invert sugar. Profile Invert sugar is an equimolecular mixture of glucose and fructose which may be prepared by the hydrolysis of sucrose with a suit- able mineral acid such as hydrochloric acid. Invert sugar has sim- ilar actions and uses to those of glucose (p.1945) and fructose (p.1945). It has been used as a 10% solution as an alternative to glucose in parenteral nutrition but, as with fructose, such use can- not be recommended. A syrup of invert sugar is used as a stabilising agent; when mixed with suitable proportions of sucrose-based syrup it will help to prevent crystallisation of the sucrose.
